reason: I bill cost-plus, so I wouldn't eat $1,500 a home across a big plan library, and I'd only add it as a line item if the homeowner agrees to pay. Most of my buyers are spec and Parade of Homes traffic who walk a model or look at renderings I already have.
objection: Who pays? The homeowner has to agree to a line item, and on spec homes there's no homeowner to bill, so it comes out of my margin on every plan.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower per-plan price or a flat library deal, plus proof that homeowners will actually sign off on the line item or that it closes spec sales faster.
